arm-cortex-simulator.title: Play Signal Bench
arm-cortex-simulator.note: The actual browser teaching simulator. Sensor data and timing are modeled; no physical MCU is connected.

tcp-converter.title: Try conversion logic
tcp-converter.note: A functional browser adaptation of the Python formulas and constants. The TCP server and concurrent clients are not running in this preview.

campaign-os.title: Watch actual app walkthrough
campaign-os.note: Recording from the source repository. Live generation requires a configured server, user account and provider API credentials.

arns-travel-system.title: Watch actual desktop walkthrough
arns-travel-system.note: Actual Java Swing application using example traveller data. This planner does not contact suppliers or make bookings.

remnant.title: Watch actual CLI walkthrough
remnant.note: Actual terminal commands against a temporary example database. The full project runs locally in Python.

studymind.title: Live app needs deployment
studymind.note: The API and database need hosting, account/session configuration and a server-side Claude API credential before visitors can generate material.

smart-write.title: Inference demo needs a running model API
smart-write.note: The drawing frontend needs the saved PyTorch model and a running inference service. No predictions are invented in this portfolio preview.

asl-recognition.title: Camera demo needs an HTTPS deployment
asl-recognition.note: Palm needs its Node API and same-origin MediaPipe model/WASM assets. Camera permission must be requested only after a visitor chooses to start it.

fitforge.title: Try the FitForge browser companion
fitforge.note: A functional browser companion with the native exercise catalog: build a routine, log actual sets and save local history. It is separate from the SwiftUI app and does not include Apple Health or nutrition.

hubspot-integration.title: CRM demo needs a test account
hubspot-integration.note: A public demo needs isolated sample records, a HubSpot test account, custom-object configuration and a server-side private-app token.

mood-picker.title: Live deployment needs restoring
mood-picker.note: The published Vercel URL returned DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND during this review. The Flask/React source can run locally; it needs a configured host before a live button can be enabled.

jetson-nano-robot.title: Hardware walkthrough needed
jetson-nano-robot.note: This project needs the actual robot and camera. A recording of the device working is needed for a faithful portfolio demonstration.

vex-robotics.title: Competition footage needed
vex-robotics.note: Add an actual robot or match recording to demonstrate drivetrain and control behavior. No competition footage was supplied in the current project sources.

fpv-racing-sim.title: FPV recording needed
fpv-racing-sim.note: The physical camera and viewing setup need an actual recording. No live camera feed or fabricated hardware result is shown here.
